raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19, business date 2026-01-18) delivers customer_id without zero-padding ('C52', 'C3', 'C143' instead of 'C00052' and so on). Those rows fail the inner join to the customer dimension, which drops 324 posted transactions from gold_region_daily; gold_customer_spend is also split across two ID formats. The mapping back to the canonical 'C' plus 5-digit format is deterministic, so I normalize customer_id in silver_transactions.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(customer_id, 'C[0-9]+') THEN 'C' || lpad(CAST(CAST(substr(customer_id, 2) AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR), 5, '0') ELSE customer_id END AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
